summary: Upstream behavior parity audit against the unchanged reviewed npm baselines in Porting/upstream-lock.json, with Swift-reachable upstream tests translated for every corrected path. Validation: per-package suites, the complete root compatibility suite, generation, catalog and tooling checks; see Docs/Archive/UpstreamParityAudit20261116.md. Publication is gated by exact-source Swift 6.3.3 hosted CI. Paid/live-service checks were not run.

packages.notes: Upstream parity audit of `ai` and `@ai-sdk/provider-utils`. `AI.generateImage` now splits `count` above the model's `maxImagesPerCall` (new `ImageModel` requirement, default 1, plus a call-level `maxImagesPerCall:` and `AIImageModelMiddleware.overrideMaxImagesPerCall`) into concurrent calls with per-call retries. Retries report `maxRetriesExceeded` after the budget and parse `retry-after(-ms)` like upstream; embedMany merges provider metadata across chunks and reports `ai.embedMany`; rerank skips empty documents and fills response metadata; empty-text reasoning with provider metadata is replayed between steps and kept by UI conversion. `isURLSupported` matches media types exactly, JSON parsing follows `JSON.parse`, `withoutTrailingSlash` removes one slash, caller `Content-Type`/`User-Agent` override defaults case-insensitively and streamed tool-call IDs use upstream's 16-character form. New helpers `aiFunctionToolInputSchema` (and related accessors) and `validateBaseURL`.
packages.compatibility: Additive public API (protocol requirement with a default, new parameters with defaults, new helpers). Custom `ImageModel` conformers without a limit now receive one image per call, as upstream; declare `maxImagesPerCall` to keep larger calls.

packages.notes: `convertToModelMessages` keeps empty-text reasoning that carries provider metadata, converts assistant reasoning-file parts and inlines non-image `data:` URL files instead of throwing.
packages.compatibility: Source-compatible; changes are additive. Request bodies, results, warnings and errors change to match the reviewed upstream package.

packages.notes: Chat sends `json_schema` for schema output and leaves the schema unchanged; unsupported `flex`/`priority` service tiers are removed with upstream warnings; search-preview models drop `temperature`; `reasoningSummary` no longer leaks into chat bodies. Responses applies and strips `systemMessageMode`, `passThroughUnsupportedFiles` and `includeWebSearchSources`, keeps prompt-cache breakpoints, image detail and filenames, and orders GPT-6 warnings like upstream. Function tools send only their input schema as parameters.
packages.compatibility: Source-compatible; changes are additive. Request bodies, results, warnings and errors change to match the reviewed upstream package.
